description: Code edits and local code jobs on their own branch, code generation with GitHub Copilot's inline completion (S5) checked by the examples, the project's tests and a stress test (brute force and random inputs for contest-style code and retries); contest-style code goes to Copilot only when a bundled difficulty classifier calls it easy, docstrings, error triage, renames, code explanation. Copilot sends the code it completes to GitHub (egress).
